verdict.rationale: Better Stack documents one native bulk action: acknowledging many simultaneously created incidents with a single tap. That is a genuine first-party bulk operation, but it is limited to incident acknowledgement. The API evidence only shows per-item create, update and delete endpoints, which are building blocks rather than bulk operations, so it earns no credit. Missing for 10: bulk edit/delete/create across monitors and other resources, bulk API endpoints, bulk operations via MCP/AI workflows, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: 30 incidents get created at the same time. Acknowledge them with a single tap and stop your phone from ringing.
10 incidents created at the same time? Acknowledge them with a single tap and keep your phone from ringing while fixing the issue.
